about: Cases for the plugin manifest, format 1. Each case is the base manifest with its top-level fields in `change` replaced (null removes the field). An `accept` case must parse; a `refuse` case must be refused with a message containing `error`. Copy this file to check another reader agrees.

accept.name: a choice whose default is an option
a browse view of its own kind

refuse.name: an id with no owner
an id with capitals
an id with three parts
a version with two numbers
a version starting with v
a version with a leading zero
another format
a field not in the format
a reuse value not on the list
a tool not on the list
a tool on the wrong kind of collection
refuse.error: grep works on a documents collection, and ped is pedagogy

refuse.name: a tool with no collection of its kind
refuse.error: outcomes works on a curriculum collection, and the plugin has none

refuse.name: a tool on a collection that is not there
a tool naming a setting that is not there
two collections with the same id
a collection inside another's folder
refuse.error: collections.1.path: c/inner is inside c, the folder of a

refuse.name: a collection holding another's folder
refuse.error: collections.1.path: c/inner, the folder of b, is inside c

refuse.name: the same tool twice on one collection
refuse.error: entries is declared twice for ped

refuse.name: a tool using a setting of another collection
refuse.error: hide is for ped2, and this tool is on ped

refuse.name: a collection path with ..
refuse.error: must be a relative path inside the plugin

refuse.name: an absolute collection path
refuse.error: must be a relative path inside the plugin

refuse.name: a Windows collection path
refuse.error: must be a relative path inside the plugin

refuse.name: an unknown kind of collection
a skill path with ..
refuse.error: must be a relative path inside the plugin

refuse.name: an unknown setting type
an unknown setting effect
an effect on the wrong type of setting
refuse.error: hide_ids needs a setting of type entries

refuse.name: a choice default that is not an option
refuse.error: the default must be one of the options

refuse.name: a choices default that is not among the options
refuse.error: the default must be a list of the options

refuse.name: a choice with no options
an entries default that is not a list
refuse.error: the default must be a list of ids

refuse.name: a browse view of another kind
refuse.error: the pedagogy view cannot show docs
